exposure.needed: whether the operator runs `flux create tenant` and wants a custom service-account name; operator CLI usage is not carried in manifests, values, or workload configuration

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 makes the service-account name configurable in the `flux create tenant` CLI command (an added capability); the release note names no specific flag and states no change to existing behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-7934fe792cbf] only says that the service-account name can now be set in the `flux create tenant` CLI command. It names no flag, and it does not mention any removal, changed default or failure. Whether someone runs a CLI command on their workstation does not appear in manifests, Helm values or workload configuration. So a static predicate cannot express exposure, and undecidable with environment-visibility-gap is the right shape. P2's cli-flag leaf is wrong: it treats the command name as a container argument of Flux's workloads.
